في التصويب بعصا التحكم."}],"de":[{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:00.100000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.100000000","text":"Stell dir vor, wir platzieren den rechten Stick
mitten auf dem Bildschirm, wie hier."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.333000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:05.443000000","text":"Es steuert die Kamera,
solange ich den Stick bewege."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:05.467000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.267000000","text":"Aus der Totzone in der Mitte."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.566000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","text":"Die Totzone verhindert, dass ein leicht dezentrierter Stick"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:13.866000000","text":"die Kamera unbeabsichtigt dreht,
aber dadurch fühlt sich das Zielen auch irgendwie steif an."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:14.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:17.266000000","text":"Was, wenn wir mit null Totzone beim Stick-Zielen spielen wollen?"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:17.266000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:20.266000000","text":"Lasst uns das
Fadenkreuz so an den Stick befestigen."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:20.900000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:23.666000000","text":"Jetzt werden selbst winzige Bewegungen der Sticks,
die zu klein sind,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:23.666000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:26.666000000","text":"die Kamera zu drehen, nützlich sein können, um dein Zielen anzupassen."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:26.800000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:28.640000000","text":"Deswegen nennen wir das hier die S/R Tweak Zone."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:29.533000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:31.800000000","text":"In deinen Controller-Einstellungen kannst du die Tweakzone"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:31.800000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:34.700000000","text":"auf einen Teil des Bereichs 
für die Stickbewegung begrenzen."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:34.700000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:37.000000000","text":"Du kannst sogar dafür sorgen, dass das Fadenkreuz
deine Totzone nicht verlässt."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:38.133000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:40.300000000","text":"Oder du machst es wie ich
und drehst deine Optimierungszone hoch,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:40.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:42.713000000","text":"um den vollen Umfang
der Bewegung deines rechten Sticks zu erfassen."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:43.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:45.600000000","text":"Es gibt Einstellungen zur Auswahl,
wenn die Tweakzone aktiv ist,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:45.600000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:48.600000000","text":"und um den Effekt des Sticks auf das Fadenkreuz größer oder kleiner zu machen."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:49.233000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:51.809000000","text":"Die Tuningzone hat keine Auswirkungen auf deine reguläre Totzone für die Kamerasteuerung"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:51.833000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:53.933000000","text":"und es ändert nichts daran, wie die Zielerfassungshilfe funktioniert."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:53.933000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:57.566000000","text":"Diese funktionieren gleichzeitig mit der Anpassungszone, betreffen aber nur die Kamera."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:58.000000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:01.000000000","text":"Alle diese Fadenkreuzbewegungen 
liegen beim Spieler."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:01.083000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:03.495000000","text":"Es braucht vielleicht etwas Übung
und ein paar Einstellungen anzupassen,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:03.519000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:04.922000000","text":"um dich an die Tweakzone zu gewöhnen,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:04.946000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:07.900000000","text":"aber solange dein Controller
nicht selbst eine Totzone hinzufügt,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:08.133000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:11.600000000","text":"sorgt die Tweakzone dafür, 
dass deine Zielhilfe nicht ignoriert wird"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:11.600000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:14.800000000","text":"und du hast mehr Kontrolle über dein Zielen mit Sticks als jemals zuvor."}],"en":[{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:00.100000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.100000000","text":"Imagine we put the right stick
in the middle of the screen like this."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.333000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:04.400000000","text":"It steers the camera"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:04.400000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.400000000","text":"as long as I move the stick
out of the dead zone in the middle."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.566000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","text":"The dead zone keeps a slightly off
center stick from spinning"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:13.866000000","text":"the camera unintentionally,
but it also makes aiming kind of stiff."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:14.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:17.266000000","text":"What if we want zero dead
zone stick aiming?"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:17.266000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:20.266000000","text":"Let's attach
the crosshair to the stick like this."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:20.900000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:23.666000000","text":"Now, even tiny stick movements
that are too small"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:23.666000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:26.666000000","text":"to turn the camera can be useful
for tweaking your aim."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:26.800000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:29.600000000","text":"That's why we call this tweak zone."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:29.600000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:31.800000000","text":"In your controller settings,
you can limit the tweak zone"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:31.800000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:34.700000000","text":"to just a portion
of your stick's range of movement."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:34.700000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:37.000000000","text":"Even confine the crosshair
to stay in your dead zone."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:38.133000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:40.300000000","text":"Or you can
do what I do and crank up your tweak zone"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:40.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:42.166000000","text":"to cover the whole range of your right
stick's"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:42.166000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:43.300000000","text":"movement."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:43.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:45.600000000","text":"There are settings to choose
when tweak zone is active,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:45.600000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:48.600000000","text":"and to make the stick's effect
on the crosshair bigger or smaller."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:49.233000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:51.333000000","text":"Tweak zone
doesn't affect your regular camera control"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:51.333000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:53.933000000","text":"dead zone and it doesn't change how aim
assist works."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:53.933000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:57.566000000","text":"Those work at the same time as tweak zone,
but only affect the camera."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:58.000000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:01.000000000","text":"All of that
crosshair movement is up to the player."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:01.200000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:03.466000000","text":"It may take some practice
and experimenting with the settings"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:03.466000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:04.833000000","text":"to get comfortable with tweak zone,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:04.833000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:07.900000000","text":"but as long as your controller
isn't adding a dead zone of its own,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:08.133000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:11.600000000","text":"tweak zone makes it so
that none of your aiming input is ignored"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:11.600000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:14.800000000","text":"and puts you in more control of your stick
aiming than ever before.
"}],"es":[{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:00.100000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.100000000","text":"Imagínate que ponemos la palanca derecha
en medio de la pantalla, así."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.333000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:05.443000000","text":"Dirige la cámara
siempre que mueva la palanca"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:05.467000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.267000000","text":"fuera de la zona sin uso en el medio."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.566000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","text":"La zona sin uso evita
que una palanca descentrada haga girar"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:13.866000000","text":"la cámara, pero también hace
que apuntar sea un poco rígido."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:14.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:17.266000000","text":"¿Y si quiero que la palanca
no tenga zona sin uso al apuntar?"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:17.266000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:20.266000000","text":"Vamos a fijar la mira
a la palanca de esta forma."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:20.900000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:23.666000000","text":"Ahora, los movimientos ligeros del stick
muy pequeños"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:23.666000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:26.666000000","text":"pueden resultar útiles
para ajustar la puntería."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:26.800000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:28.640000000","text":"Por eso lo llamamos la zona de ajuste."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:29.497000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:31.800000000","text":"En los ajustes del mando,
puedes limitar la zona de ajuste"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:31.800000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:34.603000000","text":"a solo una parte del movimiento
de la palanca."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:34.628000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:37.311000000","text":"Incluso puedes limitar la mira
para que se quede en la zona sin uso."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:38.133000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:40.457000000","text":"O puedes hacer como yo
y subir la zona de ajuste al máximo"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:40.482000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:43.050000000","text":"para cubrir todo el alcance
del movimiento de la palanca derecha."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:43.300000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:45.702000000","text":"Hay ajustes para elegir
cuándo está activa la zona de ajuste,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:45.727000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:48.600000000","text":"y para aumentar o reducir el efecto
de la palanca en la retícula."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:49.233000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:51.879000000","text":"La zona de ajuste no afecta
a la zona sin uso habitual de la cámara"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:51.904000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:53.933000000","text":"y no cambia la asistencia de apuntado."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:53.933000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:57.566000000","text":"Funciona a la vez que la zona de ajuste,
pero solo afecta a la cámara."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:57.995000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:00.875000000","text":"Todo ese movimiento de la mira
es decisión del jugador."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:01.025000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:03.286000000","text":"Tal vez necesites práctica
y experimentar con los ajustes"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:03.311000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:04.996000000","text":"para familiarizarte con la zona de ajuste."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:05.021000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:07.900000000","text":"Pero siempre que tu mando
no añada una zona sin uso propia,"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:08.133000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:11.600000000","text":"la zona de ajuste hace que no se ignore
ninguna de tus entradas de apuntado"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:01:11.600000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:01:14.800000000","text":"y te da más control que nunca
al apuntar con las palancas."}],"es-419":[{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:00.100000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.100000000","text":"Imagina que ponemos la palanca derecha
en medio de la pantalla, así."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:03.333000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:05.384000000","text":"Mueve la cámara
mientras muevo la palanca"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:05.467000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.267000000","text":"fuera de la zona sin uso en el medio."},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:07.566000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.317000000","text":"La zona sin uso evita
que la palanca descentrada mueva"},{"startTime":"+00000000.00:00:10.400000000","endTime":"+00000000.00:00:13.866000000","text":"la cámara por accidente,
